description: Searches the firm's configured shared mailbox with Gmail syntax. Returns mailbox messages. The address comes from firm configuration. Read-only. Sign-in required.

max_results.description: Max messages, newest first, 1-25. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Gmail search syntax, e.g. "from:jane@x.com newer_than:7d" or "subject:deposition".

name: search_shared_mailbox
title: Search shared mailbox
